FIELDS.NAME: Vitality Health Market
FIELDS.MAILING ADDRESS: 123 Health Way, Suite 200, Wellness City, CA 90210-1234
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Vitality Health Market specializes in the retail of vitamins, supplements, and organic health foods sourced from reputable suppliers. Our operations prioritize customer safety and satisfaction through the implementation of documented safety practices for the storage, handling, and display of all products. We ensure compliance with all applicable local, state, and federal regulations while maintaining an active Workers' Compensation policy. Our team is trained to provide accurate product information and resolve customer complaints promptly, minimizing risks related to product liability. We conduct regular inventory audits to remove expired or recalled products and maintain proper storage conditions to ensure product integrity. Additionally, our secure payment systems protect customer transactions both in-store and online, providing a trustworthy shopping experience.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses due to inventory shrinkage discovered during annual audits on 06/15/2022, primarily resulting from vendor shipping errors. Amount: $1,000. Status: Resolved. Secondary loss from a slip and fall incident in-store on 09/20/2022, settled for $1,500. Status: Resolved.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: 8:00 AM - 8:00 PM, Monday - Saturday; 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM, Sunday
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: High-security safe rated for Class B, maintained and monitored for secure storage of cash and sensitive documents, compliant with state regulations.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Fencing and 24/7 security monitoring system installed at the premises.

FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – There have been no policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years for Vitality Health Market.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Vitality Health Market does not lease employees to or from other employers, as our staffing is managed internally to ensure consistency and compliance with our operational standards.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Vitality Health Market maintains an active Workers' Compensation policy to ensure compliance with legal requirements and provide coverage for our employees.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Vitality Health Market operates another business, Health & Wellness Consulting Services, which complements our focus on promoting health and wellness.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Vitality Health Market currently holds one policy with this company and does not have any other active insurance policies.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Vitality Health Market does not engage in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations focus solely on the retail of FDA-approved vitamins, supplements, and organic health foods.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Vitality Health Market does not rent or loan equipment to others, as our operations are focused solely on retailing FDA-approved health products. This ensures we maintain a clear and compliant business model.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – The applicant has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years, maintaining a stable financial position.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Vitality Health Market does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations focus solely on the retail of FDA-approved health products without engaging in activities that involve hazardous materials.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Vitality Health Market does not have any catastrophe exposure as our operations are focused exclusively on retailing FDA-approved health products, with no involvement in activities that would significantly increase risk. We maintain comprehensive safety and compliance practices to minimize any potential risks.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Vitality Health Market has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring, maintaining a focus on compliance and employee training.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Vitality Health Market has no uncorrected fire code violations, ensuring a safe environment for both employees and customers. All necessary fire code compliance measures are actively maintained.
